title: if app closes for wahtevr reason and opens back up, tasks and aggents in progress should auto continue

items.content: Explore: app startup, session restore, turn lifecycle and quit path in aura-app
Explore: tasks board, spawned subagents, parent/child waiting, processes, what persists
Explore: AgentLoop per-iteration hooks and what the record holds mid-turn
Design the auto-resume approach and split implementation work
aura-agent: RunOptions round observer called at each point a run can continue from (full conversation + todos), never after cancel; tests
aura-app: in_turn session checkpoints saved from drive_turn's observer; restore without record replay for them; tests
aura-app: <data_dir>/inflight markers written/removed around turns and spawns; quitting leaves work in flight (no Cancelled tasks, no cancel artifacts saved); tests
aura-app: startup resume coordinator (AURA_AUTO_RESUME, crash-loop guard, same task id kept Running) continuing interrupted user-agent turns; tests
aura-app: resume interrupted task-tool subtasks bottom-up (waiting parents continue with their replies; detached report via notice); tests
Docs: cli.md, configuration.md, architecture.md, CHANGELOG for auto-resume
Reviewer pass over the auto-resume branch diff
Final fmt + clippy -D warnings + tests for aura-agent and aura-app in the worktree; fix fallout
